notes.title: Playtests are open
notes.content:
[h3]Hello builders[/h3]

The release of the House Builder VR game is getting closer. 

We thought that fans of house building would certainly like to test the possibilities of creating in the virtual reality. For you, we have prepared just such an opportunity. 

[b][h3]Starting today, you can sign up for playtests of the game. [/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686603/627714dc03a4ae60409aa3a3e49b8c00c1b9903f.jpg[/img]

[b]Here you can see the lastest gameplay and development progress of House Builder VR[/b]
[previewyoutube=DKW8p679Wr4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]SIGN UP HERE[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052760/House_Builder_VR/

More details will be announced at later date.

Have a great time playing,
House Builder VR team.
